facts.fact: Mozambique has three mobile wallet platforms run by mobile network providers offering money transfers and bill payments, with 446,604 non-bank agents of Electronic Money Institutions and 1,313 mobile money accounts per thousand adults at end-2025, per the Bank of Mozambique's Financial Inclusion Report 2025.
